pages.text: After its battle with you, the Green Smith was won over by your black magic. Still wanted by the Wither Warlord, it is sure it can live better here - and at your call it came straight to your aid.

Under your banner the Green Smith has never had it so good: it carries the $(l:supreme/servants_skills/green_smith_servant)strengthening$() you gifted it, which has firmed up and sharpened the necromantic arts it commands - and made it all the more loyal.$(br)Feed it $(item)Bones$() to heal it.

The Green Smith's focus gifts, its extra summons from soul jars, and the focus supplement are covered in the $(l:supreme/servants_skills/necromancer_extra_summons)Necromancers' Extra Summons$() skill compendium; the soul-jar supplement is in the $(l:supreme/servants_skills/green_smith_servant)Green Smith's own skill compendium$().
